title: Unit Digits and finding number of zeroes (Level 3)

questions.q_en: What is the unit's digit of the sum 1 + 22 + 33 + 44 + 55?
questions.solution_en:
22 = 4; 33 = 27; 44 = 256; 55 = 3125

Sum = 1+ 4 + 27+ 256 + 3125 = 3413

Alternate:

The quicker way to solve questions like this is to know the repetitive tendency of the unit digits of the powers of numbers 1-9.

For example, any power of numbers with unit digits 1, 5 and 6 would always have the unit digit as 1, 5 and 6 itself respectively. Every odd power of number with unit digit 4 would have unit digit as 4 and every even power would have the unit digit as 6. Unit digits of powers of 2 and 3 repeat for every power of 4, i.e., unit digit of 21 is same as 25, unit digit of 22 is same as 26, unit digit of 33 is same as 37 etc.

=> Sum of the unit digits = 1 + 4 + 7 + 6 + 5 = 23 => Unit digit would be 3.

questions.q_en: The total number of digits used in numbering the pages of a book having 400 pages is
questions.solution_en:
Total number of digits = (no. of digits in 1*digit page nos. + no. of digits in 2*digit page nos. + no. of digits in 3*digit page nos.)

= (1 x 9 + 2 x 90 + 3 x 301)

=(9 + 180 + 903)

= 1092

questions.q_en: If the positions of the digits of a two digit number are interchanged, the number obtained is smaller than the original number by 27. If the digits of the number are in the ratio of 2 : 1 then what is the original number?
questions.solution_en:
Let the original number be = 10a + b

According to the question; 10a + b = 10b + a + 27

=> 9a = 9b + 27

=> a = b + 3... (1)

According to the question; a/b=2/1

=> a = 2b... (2)

From Equation (1) and (2) we will get;

=> 2b = b + 3

=> b = 3

Hence; a = 6

Therefore original number = 63

Express Method

By checking options,

48 - 84 = -36 (not correct)

36 - 63 = -27 (not correct)

63 - 36 = 27. (Correct)

Hence original number = 63

questions.q_en: What is the number of zeroes at the end of 89!?
questions.solution_en:
Maximum power of 5 in 89!

= [89/5] + [89/25]

= 17 + 3

= 20

So, number of zeroes in 89! = 20

questions.q_en: What is the unit digit of 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545?
questions.solution_en:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

NumberCyclicityUnit digit values
Power 1Power 2Power 3Power 4
010
111
242486
343971
4246
515
616
747931
848426
9291

(Note: when remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

In the given series 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545, we can see that power of every next term is increased by 4 than power of previous number and from cyclicity table, we can see the cyclicity of numbers from 0 to 9.

Now, from cyclicity, we know unit digit of 5th power of 5 will be 5, 9th power of 6 will be 6 and so on.

Then, unit digit of 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545 = unit digit of (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + .. + 15)

In the above series,

First term = 5 = a

Last term = 15 = an

Common difference = d = 6 - 5 = 1

Then, an = a + (n - 1)d

15 = 5 + (n - 1) x 1

n = 11

Then, unit digit of (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + .. + 15)

= unit digit of (n/2)(a + an)

= unit digit of (11/2)(5 + 15)

= unit digit of 110

= 0

questions.q_en: When digits of a two-digit number are reversed and added to the number, then the resultant is 143. If the difference between the digits is 1, then find product of the digits.
questions.solution_en:
Let the two-digit number = 10a + b, where a and b are tens and unit digits.

When digits of the number are interchanged, then new number = 10b + a

Now, 10a + b + 10b + a = 143

11a + 11b = 143

a + b = 13

Difference between digits = (a - b) or (b - a) = 1

a = (13 - 1)/2 = 6, b = 13 - 6 = 7

or b = (13 - 1)/2 = 6, a = 13 - 6 = 7

So, the number can be 67 or 76.

Product of digits = 6 * 7 = 42

questions.q_en: Sum of digits of a 3-digit number is 13 and its unit digit is 3 times of the digit at hundreds place. If unit digit is 1 more than tens digit, then find the number.

The sum of three digits of a number is 18. The digit in hundreds place is twice the digit in tens place and the digit in tens place is 2/3 rd of the digit in ones place. Find the product of the digits of the number.
questions.solution_en:
Let, the digit in ones place = m

Digit in tens place = 2m/3

Digit in hundreds place = 2 * 2m/3 = 4m/3

m + 2m/3 + 4m/3 = 18

=> 9m/3 = 18

=> m = 6

Hence, the number = 846

Product of the digits of the number = 8*4*6 = 192

questions.q_en: How many zeroes are there in the product of 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6!?
questions.solution_en:
Since every pair of 2 and 5 gives a zero and in consecutive numbers, multiple of 5 occurs less than multiple of 2, so we need to count only fives.

To find the number of fives in 10*9*8*....*1 we will divide the maximum number (i.e. 10) by 5 and count only quotient i.e. 2.

So, total number of fives in 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6! = (10/5) + (9/5) + (8/5) + (7/5) + (6/5)

= 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1

= 6

Hence, there are six zeroes in 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6!.

questions.q_en: What is the number of trailing zeros in 308!?
questions.solution_en:
Number of zeroes = number of pairs of 2 * 5

Quotient of 308/5 = 61

Quotient of 61/5 = 12

Quotient of 12/5 = 2

Total number of zeroes = 61 + 12 + 2 = 75

questions.q_en: Find the number of trailing zeros in 28 * 73 * 56.
questions.solution_en:
Number of trailing zeros in 2x * 5y form will be min(x, y). [min => minimum]

In 28 * 73 * 56 , number of trailing zeros = 6 (as 6 is less than 8)

questions.q_en: Find the number of trailing zeros in 1024! .
questions.solution_en:
Number of trailing zeros in n! = highest power of 5 in n!

According to question,

1024/51 + 1024/52 + 1024/53 + 1024/54

= 204 + 40 + 8 + 1

= 253

Hence, number of trailing zeros is 253.

questions.q_en: First ten even natural numbers are multiplied with the first five multiples of five. Find out the number of zeros at the end of the product?
questions.solution_en:
Required multiplication = 2 X 4 X 6 X 8 X 10 X 12 X 14 X 16 X 18 X 20 X 5 X 10 X 15 X 20 X 25

Here number of zeros = number of complete pairs of 2 & 5

= number of 5 (since, n (5) < n (2))

= 8

questions.q_en: If A = 43 + 83 + 123 + .... + 443 and B = 122 + 182 + 242 + .... + 542, then what is the difference between unit digit of A and B?
questions.solution_en:
A = 43 + 83 + 123 + .... + 443

A = 64 * (13 + 23 +33 + ... + 113)

Here, we know that, (13 + 23 + 33 + ... + n3) = (n(n + 1)/2)2

Then, A = 64 * ((11(11 + 1)/2)2) = 278784

Unit digit of A = 4

Similarly, B = 122 + 182 + 242 + .... + 542

B = 36 * ((22 + 32 + 42 + ... + 92) - 12)

Here, we know that, (12 + 22 + 32 + ... + n2) = n(n + 1)(2n + 1)/6

Then, B = 36 * ((9(9 + 1)(18 + 1)/6) - 1) = 10224

Unit digit of B = 4

Therefore, difference between unit digit of A and B = 4 - 4 = 0

questions.q_en: What is the unit digit of (116111 + 39256 + 108123 - 66493)?
questions.solution_en:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

In 116111:

Unit digit of 116 is 6 and cyclicity of 6 is 1.

So, we have to divide the power of 116 i.e.111 by 1.

After dividing 111 by 1, remainder = 0. So, power = cyclicity = 1

Unit digit of 61 = 6

In 39256:

Unit digit of 392 is 2 and cyclicity of 2 is 4.

So, we have to divide the power of 392 i.e.56 by 4.

After dividing 56 by 4, remainder = 0. So, power = cyclicity = 4

Unit digit of 24 = 6

In 108123:

Unit digit of 108 is 8 and cyclicity of 8 is 4.

So, we have to divide the power of 108 i.e.123 by 4.

After dividing 123 by 4, remainder = 3. So, power ≠ cyclicity

Unit digit of 83 = 2

In 66493:

Unit digit of 664 is 4 and cyclicity of 4 is 2.

So, we have to divide the power of 664 i.e.93 by 2.

After dividing 93 by 2, remainder = 1. So, power ≠cyclicity

Unit digit of 41 = 4

Therefore, unit digit of (116111 + 39256 + 108123 - 66493)

= unit digit of (6 + 6 + 2 - 4)

= 0
